integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. The packaged exact-rational checker replays the stated algorithm on the explicit equality family for all 2<=N<=30 and all 2<=K<=N; these finite checks are corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts only step-4 element tests in exact arithmetic for Condat's published ordering semantics; it is not a full implementation-time bound. A close 2026 weighted dynamic-threshold preprint could not be inspected in full, so an equivalent support-conditioned formula there remains a residual originality risk.
title: A sharp support-sensitive cleanup bound for Condat's simplex projection algorithm
